Edit the Compliance Lightning App: Setup > Apps > App Manager > Compliance> Edit. ![Lightning Experience App Mgr](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Lightning%20Experience%20App%20Mgr.png){height="" width=""} 2. Click on Navigation Items in the App Settings. 3. Add the Audit tab to the Selected Items. ![click audit](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/click%20audit.png){height="" width=""} 4. Press {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![press save](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/press%20save.png){height="" width=""} 5. Navigate back to the Compliance Lightning App. **NOTE:** Sometimes Lightning Tabs don't show up right away. You may need to refresh a few times or log out/in in order for the Audit Tab to show.
